These include all available plugins for your chosen architecture. - Documentation is available on readthedocs for both |fledge-doc| and |foglamp-doc| and includes details of the plugins available for each. **This repository is now archieved.** FogLAMP is an open source platform for the **Internet of Things**, and an essential component in **Fog Computing**.
